Steps to access Vitrine settings:

1.) Open Spotify
2.) Tap on your Spotify profile picture on the top corner
3.) Tap Mod Settings
4.) Tap on Premium, ads & privacy
5.) Toggle ON: Hide ads, Hide upsells, Spoof Premium
6.) Restart Spotify
Steps to Download Songs:

1.) Play the song you want to download. Tap the Download button. If that doesn't work, follow steps 2-5
2) Press and hold the Home tab bar to Open Vitrine settings
3.) Tap on Pixie Download Manager
4.) Tap Download current track
5.) Once downloaded, a green downloaded icon 📥 appears next to the song
